items.title: Ultimate Hill Base 2
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Are you ready to take it to the next level?
With this new epic hillbase, you will not have to worry about how to survive.
The only thing you have to worry about is what awesome thing you will do first.

+ Hill Base
+ Secret
+ Survival 
+ Underground 
+ Includes: Village, indoor mine-cart rolecoster, redstone for days! , detailed interior, new and more challenges, and more!

items.title: Chefs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
This pack is *chefs kiss*

*12 chefs
*2 skins free

items.title: Angels and Demons
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Confront the dark parts of yourself, or work to banish them with illumination and forgiveness. Your willingness to wrestle with your demons will cause your angels to sing with this new pack!

*12 Angels and Demons
*2 skins free

items.title: Chibi Demons
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Who says demons have to be scary?

*12 chibi demons
*2 free skins

items.title: June Skins of the Month
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Summer is in full bloom and these skins are living large. Beat the heat with 14 skin specially crafted for the month of June. Steve-sized ice cream cones, a beach bummin' sun, ninja frogs, famous DJ's, a superhero shark and more! This pack is a party, make a splash, dive right in!

items.title: Camo Blocks: Plains
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Disappear in plain sight with this 'Camo Blocks: Plains' skinset! Be the ultimate stealth ninja and hide right in front of your friends!

- 8 camo skins!
- Roleplay as your favourite Minecraft blocks!

items.title: Potatoes
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
As the saying goes, when life gives you potatoes make some cool skins! Dress up in a variety of potato based outfits, because why not?

+ 7 potato outfits
+ A variety of designs; from a princess potato to a miner.

items.title: Pirate Costumes
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Ahoy me hearties! Put on these pirate costumes and set sail in the seven seas!

+ 12 teens dressed as pirates
+ Peglegs, eyepatches and other cool pirate clothes

items.title: FarmCraft
items.creator: Blockworks
items.description:
FarmCraft is an introduction to modern agriculture; the machines, processes, and factors that go into producing our food today. Learn about agriculture and farming through the experience of growing your own crops, harvesting them and replanting. Content sponsored by John Deere.

-Educational adventure
-Custom farm vehicles
-From: BlockWorks & John Deere

items.title: Neon Demons
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Be bright and colorful with this epic neon demons skin pack!
One free skin!

items.title: Cute Colorful Unicorns
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Cute Colorful Unicorns! Embark on your adventures with one of twelve unique unicorn designs perfect for animal lovers. This pack is great for survival or roleplay! Become a rainbow, butterfly, or even a star and stand out from the crowd.

+12 skins

items.title: Disco Fashion
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Amazing outfits, lots of music, and even more fun! Don't waste your time and shine like a star with this Disco Fashion skin pack!
Dress up for some amazing dance nights together with your friends and show off your best moves!

+ 12 cute skins!
+ 1 FREE skin!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Red Flying Fortress
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
High up, hidden in between the clouds lies a legendary castle. Many stories have been told about its illustrious history. All alone and abandoned it is yearning for people to return. Step into the past and venture around the castle grounds!

- Survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Farmers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Be the talk of the barn with these amazing anime inspired farmer skins.

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Demon Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These mobs have been cursed and now roam around as demons, looking for any opportunity to frighten everyone they come across! Join the fun and scare your friends with these ghoulishly amazing mob skins!

- 10 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Pyjama Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
It’s slumber party time and every mob has been invited. Show up in your best pyjama and be the life of the party!

- 12 awesome skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Samurai Palace
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Behold the stunning beauty and might of the Samurai Palace. Immerse yourself in the thousand years old ways of life and embrace the traditions. Are you up for the challenge?

- Survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Ninjas
items.creator: DigiPort
items.description:
Wait! Did you see that? Over there! In the shadows, are those ninjas? *shocked face* 

Will you hide in the shadows or leap out against your foes? Your destiny awaits!

+ 12 cool ninja skins
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Freedom Fashion
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Free your spirit among these crazy teens! Let your inner spirit shine while living your best years of life! Drive fancy cars and buy big mansions while trying the newest trends. Go hiking, parkour through the modern city, or just enjoy the urban landscapes. Teens can't wait to meet you and become your new friend!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 teen skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Neko Mermaids HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Bringing a whole new meaning to the name catfish, these lovely creatures are part mermaid and part feline! Rock a cute anime style under the sea with nekos and their human counter parts. Includes shark, turtle, and crab onesies!

+ 18 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Camo Teens HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
For those who want to dress up in some army styled fashion without the work. Be a cute camo styled teen and blend in with your environment! 

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Giant House
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Minaturized, dive into the middle of your home and discover a new point of view!
Explore a gigantic world and find ingredients to regain your original size. Fight against cockroaches and soar on the back of a fly!

- A fully scenarised adventure!
+ One "Dr. Phil" skin included!
- Giants insects to fight against!
- An epic boss fight!
- By Pixelusion & leoop0

items.title: Venus Base
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description:
Blast off and visit this futuristic space station on Venus! Carry out some important science experiments, do some farming in the laboratories or go on your own spacewalk! With so much to explore, you’ll never want to return home!

- Custom vehicles!
- Huge space station!

By BBBStudios

items.title: Cute Fashion Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The ultimate in fashion is here! What are you waiting for to buy these beautiful skins? Be the most stylish person wherever you go, make a difference, and don't wait more!

+10 Cute Fashion Teens
+1 free Cute Fashion Teens
by UnderBlocks
